_README: Single source of truth for every fact that appears in a caption, an image, or the JSON-LD schema. Answer engines reward EXACT string consistency across Instagram, Facebook, Google Business Profile, Naver and the booking site. Change a fact here, never in a caption.

entity.name: Laurel Studio
entity.tagline: Where ancient earth meets modern skincare science.
entity.positioning: Personalized K-beauty skincare studio — a studio, not a spa
entity.one_line_definition: Laurel Studio is a personalized K-beauty skincare studio in Hongdae, Seoul, founded by Hana Kim, a former cosmetics ingredient researcher. Guests receive a skin assessment and care matched to their skin on the day, on a traditional Ondol floor in a maru space.

location._note: Publicly published: district, neighbourhood, street address, floor, nearest station. This is the entity anchor — do not remove it from any profile.
location.nearest_station: Hongik University Station Exit 1 (Line 2 · AREX · Gyeongui–Jungang)
location._latlng_note: Fill from Google Maps once the listing exists — right-click the pin, copy coordinates. Needed for the geo block in aeo/schema.jsonld.

contact._note: Empty strings are optional — the pipeline only blocks on TODO_ values. Fill booking_url and facebook_page before go-live; the rest improve schema completeness.

operations.booking_lead_time: Same-day booking is possible; specific hours fill first
operations.usd_krw_note: KRW is the charged amount; USD figures are the published equivalents.
operations.walk_in_policy: If the door is closed, message us — we may be momentarily out and will return shortly.

services.name: Signature Custom Facial
services.summary: The essential custom facial — cleansing and layering matched to your skin on the day, never a fixed menu.
includes: Skin assessment before anything is applied
Cleansing and light exfoliation matched to your barrier
Moisturizing cream for glow and barrier care
services.best_for: A first visit, and a clean reset.

services.name: Premium Custom Care + Skin Report
services.summary: The full custom facial, plus a written skin report — your skin type, what your barrier is doing, and which products to use and skip.
includes: Full skin assessment and written Skin Report
Extended facial massage for skin and mind balance
Product guidance by email, including what not to buy
services.best_for: Guests who want to leave Seoul knowing what their skin actually needs.
services.unique: The only program that includes the written Skin Report and product guidance.

services.name: Décolleté & Body Care
services.summary: Décolleté, shoulders and face cared for by hand, while a spinal-care device works along the back.
includes: Spinal-care device works along the back
Décolleté and shoulder care by your therapist
services.best_for: Long flights and heavy walking days — body relief alongside the facial.
services.important_disclaimer: This is not a full-body massage. A spinal-care device — a warm heated bed — works along the back, while your therapist focuses on décolleté, shoulders and face.
services._disclaimer_note: This line must appear in every caption, card and schema entry for this service. Mis-set expectations are the fastest route to a bad review.

differentiators: Founded by Hana Kim, a former cosmetics ingredient researcher with a master's in bioengineering.
Care is matched to your skin on the day — there is no fixed treatment menu.
Guests leave knowing which Korean products suit them and which to skip.
Consultation and treatment are delivered in English, start to finish.
8,000+ recorded skin consultations, guests from 50+ countries.
Three minutes from Hongik University Station Exit 1.

audience.primary: International visitors to Seoul booking a personalized K-beauty assessment, from 50+ countries
audience.secondary: Long-stay expats in the Hongdae and Yeonnam area

compliance._note: Skincare, not medical. These words stay out of every caption.
safe_framings: personalized to your skin on the day
compliance.evidence_rule: Every mechanistic claim must trace to primary literature. Cite the limitation alongside the finding.

founder.name: Hana Kim
credentials: Former executive at a global cosmetics company
founder.why_it_matters: The assessment is read by someone who formulated ingredients before she applied them. That is the positioning — expertise in diagnosis, not a treatment menu.
founder._aeo_note: Named, credentialed expertise is the single strongest E-E-A-T signal a studio this size can own. Hana Kim should appear by name in the bio, on the site, in the schema, and in roughly one post a month.

proof._note: Use exactly as written. Never round up, never write review text on a guest's behalf. Update the counts here when they move; captions read from this file.

space._language_rule: Refer to the floor only as 'Ondol Floor' or 'Traditional Ondol'. Temperature descriptors are banned brand-wide — see brand.json voice.banned_words.

core_belief.headline: Barrier first. Repair before actives.
principles: We assess what your skin can currently tolerate before recommending anything.
We routinely tell guests what not to buy.
We recommend from Olive Young, Daiso and pharmacies — not only what we sell.
Fewer products is more reliably protective than better products.
'Natural' is not a guarantee of safety.
An ingredient list is not complete information.
core_belief.stance: We are the opposite of the ten-step routine.
